input.summary: Ungate PB's at-will termination right (30 days' notice, no $60M spend threshold) and delete SFJ's sole-discretion termination on JSC disagreement.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need a real exit right, so we have removed the $60 million spend threshold and the pre-first-approval window from Section 14.2.2 and fixed notice at thirty (30) days; as drafted we would be locked in for the early years of a multi-year program. We have also deleted Section 14.2.10, which lets SFJ walk away in its sole discretion on immediate notice merely because it disagrees with a decision PB is entitled to make (and charges us Development Costs plus 25% interest for doing so); our playbook does not accept a provider convenience right on less than 90 days' notice. We accept the 300% exit payment in Section 14.2.2 as part of the funding economics.

ops.oldText: PB may terminate this Agreement at any time after SFJ has paid or incurred a total of $60 million of Development Costs and prior to the date of receipt of the first Regulatory Approval upon [***] prior written notice to SFJ.
ops.newText: PB may terminate this Agreement at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to SFJ.
